claims: The Wisconsin Badgers women's basketball team defeated the Oregon State Beavers 62-58.
The game was in the first round of the WBIT.
The game was in Corvallis, Oregon.
The Oregon State Beavers had a 23-12 record.
Dorja Zaja scored 18 points on 8-of-10 shooting for Wisconsin.
Destiny Howell scored 13 points for Wisconsin.
T. Bolden scored 23 points for Oregon State.
Wisconsin out-rebounded the Oregon State Beavers 36-28.
The Oregon State Beavers were eliminated from the tournament
